text:
keisha: tailgate reminder! saturday 2pm kickoff watch at the lot by Gate B. i'm coordinating food + parking. whos in for a potluck? :grill:
omar: in. i'll bring sliders and my questionable playlist. :headphones:
lucas: i can bring vegetarian skewers and a portable speaker. also, does anyone have a folding table i can borrow?
tess: i have a table and 4 folding chairs. bringing them. also proposing a theme: "90s sports anthems" for the playlist. :boom:
zane: 90s anthems are a violent yes. i will bring the team flags and an inflatable horn. :loud_sound:
snackbot: @keisha Snack assignment suggestion: Burgers (omar), Veg skewers (lucas), Chips & dips (keisha), Cookies (tess), Drinks (zane). React with :thumbsup: to accept.
keisha: looks good. if someone can swap chips for potato salad thatd be perfect.
omar: i can swap if someone volunteers cookies. 
lucas: i volunteer cookies if we add a karaoke challenge: loser sings the team's anthem on stage. stakes: $10 to the charity jar. :microphone:
tess: karaoke stakes accepted. also can we sort parking? last year we had chaos.
keisha: parking options: Lot A (closer, 10 spots reserved) or Lot C (free, walk 7 mins). poll time.
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Prefer parking"  1) Lot A (reserved, limited) 2) Lot C (free, farther). Vote with :one: or :two:. Poll ends in 1h.
zane: if Lot A wins, i'll run the barricade watch to save spots. guaranteed dramatic saves. :running:
omar: note: tailgate permit requires we keep music at reasonable volume after 5pm. respect the neighbors pls.
lucas: also FYI: security might check bags. keep it chill.
tess: can someone make a quick signup doc? prefer to avoid 12 people bringing chips.
ankeisha: (oops typo) keisha: i'll do a Google Sheet. posting link in 10m.
snackbot: Update: Suggested assignments accepted by majority. Waiting on cookie swap confirmation.
keisha: sheet posted: https://docs.google.com/sheetstailgate (pls add your name and what you're bringing)
zane: side note: if we end up with leftover sliders, i volunteer to adopt them.
lucas: also match challenge: best chant wins the inflatable horn for the rest of the quarter. no hogging.
omar: bringing my camera for the inevitable slow-motion high-five. if someone clips it, drop in #random-highlights.
tess: re: karaoke: who goes first? raffle or brave volunteer?
lucas: raffle seems fair. winner picks first song.
keisha: poll update: 20m in, leaning Lot A by 8->5. will finalize when poll closes. also reminder: wear team colors.
poll-bot: Update: Poll 30m in: 18 votes. Finalizing at 1998765490.
keisha: Poll closed. Lot A wins. i've reserved 10 spots under "Redwood Tailgate". sending permit to the thread. see you saturday 1:45pm to set up. bring sunscreen and dignity. :sunglasses:
